lines.text: Previously. Plume Ogres raided a village. They were not hunting. They were running.
Their chieftain could talk. He told us about the grey pack, and a wolf who walks like a man.
His name is Kurozane. And he remembers Grey Hollow.
That is where Sieg lost his whole squad.
lines.tts: That is where Seeg lost his whole squad.

lines.text: Sieg! Tell the one about the bear and the bishop again!
lines.tts: Seeg! Tell the one about the bear and the bishop again!

lines.text: Not again. He tells it wrong every time.
I tell it right. The bear is the one who changes.
Excuse me. Which way is the wind blowing tonight?
Who are you? How did you get past the...
The ropes! Somebody cut the alarm ropes!
MARA! JOSS! Everyone, UP!
Hunters, going up? Turn back, if you are wise. The wolf is on the mountain again.
A wolf who walks like a man and wears a blade like a lord. He stops Hunters on the road and asks for a duel.
Forty Hunters said yes. Forty Hunters are buried at the shrine.
Forty. Why is it always forty?
Forty is a number that likes to be scary.
He never kills the ones who refuse. That is the strange part. Only the ones who draw.
He has rules.
He has a sense of theatre. It is not the same thing.
Would you refuse?
...Ask me when he asks.
A hot spring. An actual hot spring. Takuto, this is the most Japanese thing that has ever happened to me here.
lines.tts: A hot spring. An actual hot spring. Tah-koo-toh, this is the most Japanese thing that has ever happened to me here.

lines.text: You live in a world with a cat girl and a robot cube.
And THIS is the most Japanese thing! That should tell you how weird this world is!
Water that is already warm. I am going to live in it.
Your arm is healed. My ribs are healed. We have earned one night.
One night. The pass shrine is a day up the road. Then two more to the capital.
You keep looking up the road.
Old habit.
Sieg. You have not laughed since the village.
lines.tts: Seeg. You have not laughed since the village.

lines.text: ...Haven't I?
Ahhh. Okay. I take it back. This is better than Osaka.
lines.tts: Ahhh. Okay. I take it back. This is better than Oh-sah-kah.

lines.text: Wick. Your head is boiling the water.
Is it? Oh. Oh no. Everyone is getting out. Sorry! Sorry!
I am staying. It is perfect now.
Nemu is going to fall asleep in there.
lines.tts: Neh-moo is going to fall asleep in there.

lines.text: Then she will be the cleanest cat on the mountain.
You like him.
I do not.
You stitched his arm. You tied your wrist to his. You throw pebbles at him.
Those are all training.
The pebbles were not training. I watched. You were smiling.
...He is an idiot who walks ten steps behind everyone so he cannot hurt them. Somebody has to walk back and get him.
That is what liking someone is. Walking back to get them.
Then you like him too.
I do. He is my first friend in this life. I have only had seven, so it is a short list.
...You are impossible to argue with.
I know. I am too sleepy to lose.
You are counting again.
You noticed.
Your lips move.
...Mara. She could hit a bird at a hundred paces with a thrown knife. Joss, who snored like a landslide.
Little Pell, sixteen, who lied about her age to join. Bram and Bren, the twins. Old Hask, the cook.
Tova. Corin. Dace. Ilse, who wanted to see the sea. And Wen, who I was going to marry in the spring.
Eleven. I count them every night so I remember they were people, not a number on a Guild report.
And Kurozane was there.
Kurozane cut the ropes that would have woken us. Then he walked through our tents while the Rift opened above the pass.
I took his eye. He took Wen. That is the whole story, Takuto. There is no bear and no bishop in it.
lines.tts: I took his eye. He took Wen. That is the whole story, Tah-koo-toh. There is no bear and no bishop in it.

lines.text: I am sorry, Sieg.
lines.tts: I am sorry, Seeg.

lines.text: Don't be sorry. Rin would say be useful. Go to sleep. That would be useful.
How did you meet him? Haruki.
lines.tts: How did you meet him? Hah-roo-kee.

lines.text: Middle school. Three guys from the high school had me against a vending machine.
And he beat them up?
No. I was beating them up. Badly. He put his hand on my shoulder and said, that is enough, they get it.
And I stopped. I never stopped for anyone. I stopped for him.
Then he bought you a corn soup.
...Coffee milk. For the cat. There was a stray cat behind the machine, watching the whole thing.
The cat. THE cat.
We fed it every night for three years. Then one night he did not come, and I kept feeding it alone.
And now you are almost there. Two days.
What if he does not want to see me?
Then you feed him coffee milk until he does. It worked on the cat.
There is a letter on the gate. Nailed with a tooth.
To the Laughing Blade. At moonrise, at this gate. Come alone.
Or I visit the little cat first. Kurozane.
I am the little cat.
He knows about Nemu? How does he know about Nemu?
lines.tts: He knows about Neh-moo? How does he know about Neh-moo?

lines.text: Because he has been watching us since the Greatwood.
We all go.
No.
Sieg.
lines.tts: Seeg.

lines.text: He wants a duel. If he sees five of us, he will not fight. He will run, and he will come back for Nemu on a night I am asleep.
lines.tts: He wants a duel. If he sees five of us, he will not fight. He will run, and he will come back for Neh-moo on a night I am asleep.

lines.text: If I go alone, it ends tonight. One way or the other.
One way or the other is not good enough.
It is the only way there is, Rin. I have waited six years for him to stop running.
...I do not want to be the reason you fight.
You are not the reason, Nemu. You are just the threat. The reason is eleven names long.
lines.tts: You are not the reason, Neh-moo. You are just the threat. The reason is eleven names long.

lines.text: One more lesson. Before moonrise. Pick up the axe.
Why now?
Because if tonight goes badly, I want my last lesson to be a good one.
Attack me. First move. Always the first move.
Again. And look where my second cut will be, not my first.
Your second cut comes from the same place as the first.
Every time. Afterimage is honest. That is its weakness. Kurozane knows it. He has known for six years.
Then how do you beat him?
You make your honest cut lie. You miss on purpose, so the echo lands where he runs.
Does that work?
I have never tried it. I have been saving it. For one person.
Takuto. If I lose tonight, do not chase him. Do not open the door in that axe for me.
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh. If I lose tonight, do not chase him. Do not open the door in that axe for me.

lines.text: Go to Saint Lumen. Find your friend. That is what I want. Promise me.
...I promise to go to Saint Lumen.
That is not the whole promise.
It is the part I can keep.
...Ha. You are getting clever. I hate it.
He said alone. He did not say how far away we have to stay.
The bamboo above the gate. You can see the whole shrine from there.
Are we disobeying Sieg? We are disobeying Sieg. I love it. I hate it. I love it.
lines.tts: Are we disobeying Seeg? We are disobeying Seeg. I love it. I hate it. I love it.

lines.text: If the wolf wins, he comes for me anyway. I would rather be there when he does.
Nobody interferes unless Sieg is going to die. Nobody. Not even if he is losing.
lines.tts: Nobody interferes unless Seeg is going to die. Nobody. Not even if he is losing.

lines.text: How do we know the difference?
Losing is when he is still laughing. Dying is when he stops.
He has not laughed in a week.
...Then we watch very closely.
Valentine. If this letter reaches you, I lost a duel I picked myself. Please do not cry. Blame the allergies.
The boy is good. Better than he knows. Keep Vesper away from him, and keep Gideon making him things.
And tell Tofu I was sorry about calling him a breadbox. He was a very good breadbox.
You came alone. I almost did not believe it.
You said moonrise. It is moonrise.
Six years, Valen. I wear your mark every day. I cannot see your face on my left side.
Then stand on my right. I will try to make it quick.
There. That laugh. I hated that laugh. I came for that laugh.
Kurozane, Fang of the Grey. Draw.
Sieg Valen. Laughing Blade. Already drawn.
lines.tts: Seeg Valen. Laughing Blade. Already drawn.

lines.text: Fang Draw.
Fast. Faster than before.
You are slower, Valen. Six years of counting the dead makes an old man.
Afterimage!
I know your echo, old man! I have dreamed about it!
Second Fang!
Ngh!
Do you know what I was, Valen, before the suit found me? A hound of the Rift. A Calamity's dog, on a chain.
He broke my chain and gave me a name. I have owed him for every breath since. Even this one.
So you paid him in my squad.
I paid him in my honour. Your squad was the price of the paper it was written on.
Third Fang!
Echo!
Ha!
...Mara. Joss. Pell.
Are you praying?
Counting. Bram. Bren. Hask.
Tova. Corin. Dace. Ilse.
Missed! You MISSED!
Wen.
The echo... came from where I ran. You lied. Your blade lied.
Once. I saved it for you.
Oh, how lovely. A song. I do hate to interrupt.
Sable. This is MY duel.
Everything is yours, Kurozane, until I need it. Pack. Eat the teacher.
Of course.
Sieg!
lines.tts: Seeg!

lines.text: You followed me. All of you. I told you to stay at the inn!
You told us. We did not listen. You are a terrible influence.
Back to back! Rin, the thread!
Wrist to wrist! Go!
Fire head! Only wolves! I am getting really good at only wolves!
The suit is here, boy. In the trees. I can taste him. Let me...
Rin. It wants out.
I feel it. Your wrist is hot. Stay with me. Count with Sieg.
lines.tts: I feel it. Your wrist is hot. Stay with me. Count with Seeg.

lines.text: ...One. Two. Three.
Takuto, behind!
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh, behind!

lines.text: Four! Break!
I am not your dog, Sable.
Grey Fang. Full Moon.
He cut his own pack.
How disappointing. Well. Dogs bite. I knew that when I bought you.
Sable!
Valen. This was ours. He made it his. I will not forgive that.
We finish this another night. Without him watching.
Kurozane. My eleven. Did you laugh when you killed them?
...No. I was told to. I did not. That is the only thing I have that is mine.
You held on again. With the suit right there.
I counted. Like Sieg. One, two, three. It worked.
lines.tts: I counted. Like Seeg. One, two, three. It worked.

lines.text: Your wrist was so hot it burned me. Look.
If you say sorry I will tie your mouth shut. I mean it. I have been practising.
...Thank you, then.
Better.
I was scared tonight. Not of the wolves. Of the moment the thread would pull, and I would not be strong enough.
Then we both get stronger.
Faster than he expects. Sieg said that.
lines.tts: Faster than he expects. Seeg said that.

lines.text: Sieg says a lot of things.
lines.tts: Seeg says a lot of things.

lines.text: Most of them are even true.
Hold still. That is two cuts across your ribs. He was not playing.
Kurozane never plays. That is why he is good at it.
You stitched Takuto once. Now I stitch you. This is a very stupid family.
lines.tts: You stitched Tah-koo-toh once. Now I stitch you. This is a very stupid family.

lines.text: ...Family?
Do not make a thing of it.
Ha. Ha ha ha!
You laughed.
I did. Ow. Ha. It hurts to laugh. Rin, stop stitching while I laugh.
He laughed! The Laughing Blade laughed! Somebody write it down!
I will remember it. I am very good at remembering.
The trick worked. I made the honest blade lie. I am going to be unbearable about this for weeks.
You were already unbearable.
Now I am unbearable with reasons.
Sable was there. He bought Kurozane. He said so.
Then Sable was at Grey Hollow. Not just Kurozane. The man in the suit opened that Rift on my squad himself.
The giants. The Hydra. The ogres. Grey Hollow. Nerima. It is all him.
lines.tts: The giants. The Hydra. The ogres. Grey Hollow. Neh-ree-mah. It is all him.

lines.text: And he is going where we are going.
Okay. Fishing. I have never fished. How hard can it be?
You do not have a rod.
I have a head made of fire. Fish are attracted to light. I read that somewhere.
Where?
On a cereal box. In Osaka. Five years ago.
lines.tts: On a cereal box. In Oh-sah-kah. Five years ago.

lines.text: ...Wick. Your head is in the water.
It still works underwater! Mostly! It is just very steamy!
The fish are leaving. All of them. They are leaving the river.
...So we are having bread for lunch.
I caught three with my hands while you were boiling the river.
You are a cat! That is cheating!
I am a cat. That is fishing.
Are you counting?
A different list tonight.
Who is on it?
A girl who sleeps all day. A boy whose head is on fire. A girl with her brother's scarf. A boy with an axe that talks back.
Five. All five. Still here.
You forgot one.
Who?
You. You never count yourself. Six.
...Six.
The wolf. Three hundred years ago I knew wolves like him. They die standing up.
You liked him.
I liked that he refused. Everybody kneels to the suit eventually. That one did not.
Did you kneel? Three hundred years ago?
...Go to sleep, boy. Tomorrow you see the golden city. Look at it carefully. Gold is very good at hiding rot.
Whoa. Whoa. It is so shiny.
Saint Lumen. The golden capital.
It looks like someone dropped the sun and built houses on it.
Home of the Gilded Order, the Cathedral, and the Golden Saint himself. Lucien Aurel.
Haruki is down there.
lines.tts: Hah-roo-kee is down there.

lines.text: If Wick heard right.
I always hear right. I just do not always hear the important parts.
...Two years. I am coming, Haruki.
lines.tts: ...Two years. I am coming, Hah-roo-kee.

lines.text: Halt. State your names and your business in the holy city.
Sieg Valen, rank A, of the Ashford Guild. With four Hunters. The Order sent for us.
lines.tts: Seeg Valen, rank A, of the Ashford Guild. With four Hunters. The Order sent for us.

lines.text: Valen. And the white-haired one is the Skyfallen?
The Saint expects you. All of you. A carriage is waiting.
A carriage. A golden carriage.
Haruki got into a golden carriage. Two years ago. The guild clerk said he waved.
lines.tts: Hah-roo-kee got into a golden carriage. Two years ago. The guild clerk said he waved.

lines.text: You are not going to wave, are you?
No.
Gold, boy. Everything smells of gold here. And underneath it, something I have smelled before.
Rin. It is talking.
What does it say?
That this city is hiding something.
...Every city is. Let's go find out what.
A boy with white hair and a red jacket is coming down the mountain road. He says he is your friend.
...Takuto?
lines.tts: ...Tah-koo-toh?

lines.text: You told me nobody would come looking for you.
I told you nobody should. He never listens. He never, ever listens.
Next time: Saint Lumen, the golden capital.
The Golden Saint invites me to join the Gilded Order.
And Haruki is standing at his side. He doesn't want to be rescued.
lines.tts: And Hah-roo-kee is standing at his side. He doesn't want to be rescued.

lines.text: Episode nine. Saint Lumen.
